description: Where the track in from the northeast stops pretending to be a road: a graded turning circle, a fuel tank up on a stand with a hand pump and a gauge glass, and a plate shack with a stove pipe. A board by the door lists distances, in a column, in feet and miles, all of them correct. Somebody has left a full can of water on the step with a tin over the top of it, and it's obvious from the ring in the dust that it lives there.
name: The Dry Run
